topic: Inventory filter availability on production environment
summary_markdown: A discussion occurred regarding the availability of a working hours filter for inventory data. [p3] noted that this filter was missing from the production environment and was only visible on staging. [p5] confirmed that the feature needed activation/permission before it could be enabled, as there had been no formal decision made yet.
decisions: The working hours filter for inventory will be activated once a decision is made.
action_items: [p5] needs confirmation/authorization to activate the setting.
